claim_checks.independent_reason: The permitted q>5 congruent to 5 or 13 modulo 24 is used consistently. Simultaneous diagonalization and Cauchy-Schwarz give sum r_ij^2>=m^2/(n1 n2). Character norms 1,(q-1)^2/8,(q-1)/4 and the factor one half from the central double cover are consistent. The ideal generated by 1-z is killed by the adjoint action, while rho(z)-I has the required effect on the representation. The group-ring spanning rank argument can be applied to the complexified real Lie algebra and full rank descends. The free-quotient product dimensions cancel as stated.
